description: This file defines a React component named 'Select' that implements a custom dropdown select input using '@radix-ui/react-select'. It includes UI logic, styling, and composition of primitive components to create a stylized selection component with support for grouped options. The file exports the 'Select' component as the default export.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main React component implementing a customizable select dropdown with support for grouped options, styling, and icons.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: A forwardRef component wrapping '@radix-ui/react-select's Item, providing custom styling and indicator for each selectable item.
